title: Verify Foreman cannot delete a work order
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Foreman role. (this role has Work Orders = View/Create and Edit, NO Delete).
The work order is in Uncomplete status (a work order must be Uncomplete before it can be deleted).
steps:
1. Open the Uncomplete work order.
2. Open the work order action menu and look for a Delete option; if present, click it.
expected: Deleting the work order is BLOCKED: the Delete action is hidden/disabled or returns a permission error.
